items.title: I Used AI to Fake a Scientific Paper. Here’s What Happened
items.summary: Science has a spam problem. And the spam filter is getting clogged up. According to all reports, academic publishing is drowning in what has come to be called AI slop: low-quality, mass-produced content generated with AI.
